Run uv sync --locked --extra android and uv pip install --no-deps PATH. See docs/RESOURCES.md for the current Python 3.12 and original Python 3.11 dependency sets.
Restore the public handoff to obtain the exact recorded APK under the configured data/runtime directory. The original catalog SHA-256 and upstream terms remain applicable.

Obtain Linux x64 ChromeDriver 146.0.7680.165 from Chrome for Testing or the recorded runtime package. Check the catalog hash, grant user execute permission, bind inputs.chromedriver, and install the matching Chrome version.

resources.version: miniwob Python package 1.0; record task source revision per run
resources.how_to_get: Supply the MiniWoB task tree and record its Git revision. Install uv sync --locked --extra browser, start the task HTML service, and set MINIWOB_BASE_URL.

resources.version: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct; bind exact checkpoint files in run metadata
resources.license: See upstream model card and checkpoint attestation
resources.how_to_get: Restore the local checkpoint or explicitly download a selected Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct revision. Record the revision and file checksums; uv sync --extra inference; start dafc.models.model_frame_service with --kind qwen25vl --model PATH --audit PATH --port PORT. Save the trusted checkpoint health object as inputs.checkpoint_attestation.
